web-community-guidelines.8c8c43e5a7fd94a:
Saathum is a marketplace for real creators and real audiences. To keep it safe — especially for
    women and other groups who are too often targeted online — everyone agrees to these Community
    Guidelines. They apply across all Saathum apps and surfaces, and they work alongside our
web-community-guidelines.fb474cac2cfccea:
Many areas require a quick video identity check so every account is a genuine human. Don't
    impersonate others, run bots or burner accounts, or create fake profiles.
web-community-guidelines.fd15ed758028aa2: No harassment, bullying, threats, stalking, or hate speech.
web-community-guidelines.0af106ba8735885: No content that demeans people based on who they are.
web-community-guidelines.4f8ea6cb1b72741: Honor others' boundaries — you control who can message you, and so does everyone else.
web-community-guidelines.7d59b7005032e03: No illegal activity, sale of illegal goods, or fraud.
web-community-guidelines.6f5692d18085b03: Zero tolerance for any content that sexualizes or endangers minors.
web-community-guidelines.624a01ffcfda84c: No promotion of self-harm, violence, or dangerous behavior.
web-community-guidelines.e2d0268744a7161: No non-consensual intimate imagery, doxxing, or sharing of private information.
web-community-guidelines.f9f12b734b1e6c3: Post content you have the right to share
web-community-guidelines.3caaf01d5fa5816: Don't upload content that infringes copyright, trademarks, or other rights. See our
web-community-guidelines.cee56f77b2de18e: policy for how to report infringement.
web-community-guidelines.6402b3518bfc0e9:
Don't spam, scam, artificially inflate engagement, or manipulate payments, payouts, or the
    affiliate program.
web-community-guidelines.909076e9f1902c9:
Saathum includes AI tools. Don't use them to deceive, impersonate, or generate prohibited content.
    Remember that AI outputs can be wrong — review and label AI-generated content where appropriate.
    If you find any AI-generated image or content objectionable, tell us at
web-community-guidelines.910be4ccda8f125: and we'll review and remove it.
web-community-guidelines.09146c19cd5a6c8:
Reporting and blocking are one tap away, and we act quickly. Violations may lead to content
    removal, feature limits, or account suspension or termination, depending on severity. To report
    something, use the in-app tools or email
web-community-guidelines.0d472d17078720c:
These guidelines may evolve as our community grows. Thanks for helping keep Saathum a place for
    real people.
